thought.text: Ubuntu 22.04 only has PostgreSQL 14; the guide requires v15. I'll add the official PostgreSQL apt repository (PGDG):

reasoning_content:
Ubuntu 22.04's default repository has PostgreSQL 14, not 15. Since the documentation requires PostgreSQL v15, I need to add the official PostgreSQL apt repository (apt.postgresql.org).

Alright, let me try installing the PGDG repository.

action.command: sh -c 'echo "deb http://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt jammy-pgdg main" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/pgdg.list' && wget --quiet -O - https://www.postgresql.org/media/keys/ACCC4CF8.asc | gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/postgresql.gpg && apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -2; apt-cache policy postgresql-15 2>/dev/null | head -4
